verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of non-chat ingestion is the GitHub README's mention of storing "messages and events." This suggests Honcho takes in more than chat transcripts, but nothing documents ingesting documents, JSON payloads, or business data. Statements about modeling "any entity" and running "alongside your files" describe what Honcho represents and how it fits alongside other tools, not what it ingests, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented document/file ingestion, explicit JSON or structured-data ingestion APIs, business-data import paths, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
